# HousingCullFix
Fixes that pesky housing item pop in due to the new display limit.

## How To Use
1) Go to the ``/xlsettings`` "Experimental" tab.
2) Under Custom Plugin Repositories, enter the repository URL into the empty box at the bottom:
    * ``https://puni.sh/api/repository/abe``
3) Click the "+" button.
4) Click the "Save and Close" button.
5) Go to ``/xlplugins``
6) Install Housing Cull Fix
7) ???
8) Profit!
